failure_summary.description: Agents repeated searches instead of filtering compatible cached results, or processed an unchanged domain or unrequested proximity operation.
Agents saved undefined variables or called a search again inside the cache-save call instead of saving the assigned result.
Agents represented a return date as an arrival date on the outbound search instead of searching the reverse-direction return leg.
Agents omitted requested neighborhood constraints, inferred an unsupported traveler count, or performed proximity work without a user request.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly covers these failures: it requires saving the assigned tool result, reusing and filtering compatible cache entries, acting only on changed scopes, searching round trips as separate directional legs, mapping districts to neighborhoods, avoiding inferred party sizes, and requiring an explicit proximity request. Adding those rules again would duplicate existing content.
